suppliers.issues_basis: one row per delivery/supplier issue form submission in GC Form Task Answers (pull 2026-08-13, a rolling ~7-day window); d = earliest AnsweredDateTime on the form; supplier = the form's own 'Supplier?' answer, null when unanswered. Hand-baked from the warehouse 13/08/2026; from the first scheduled Pipe 9 run this block is built automatically and accumulates history.
suppliers.issue_categories_basis: keyword heuristic over each issue's free-text 'Issue?' answer, not an official taxonomy - only the 10-row Gmail 'Supplier Issues' feed has a real Issue Category field; buckets: shortage, damage_quality, wrong_item, temperature, invoice_credit, no_issue_recorded, other

gaps: Flow Certificates does not expose an expiry field (saw: \['certificate\_url', 'module\_name', 'trainee\_id'\])

Training completions by completion date are not in this hand-baked snapshot - that block appears on the first scheduled Pipe 9 run (2,526 completions across 22 sites are already in the warehouse, dating back to 06/08/2025).

Broth heatmap colours key off the factory spec band - tonkotsu 8.0-9.0, chicken 5.0-6.0, refractometer AFTER ice (Ross, 27 Aug 2026) - not the observed range. The band is one group-wide pair of numbers held in this builder, not a per-site or per-batch reference table in the warehouse, and GetCompliant does not record whether a reading was taken before or after ice

155 of 166 tonkotsu readings in this snapshot fall outside the 8.0-9.0 band (93%, 155 low / 0 high) - confirm sites are reading AFTER ice as the spec assumes before treating this as an estate-wide density miss rather than a measurement-basis mismatch

Fulfilment aging is a proxy, not true OTIF: the Mapal Supplier Orders/Smart Delivery/Invoices To Receive feeds fail at fetch (credentials), so there is no delivered-vs-ordered signal - fixing Mapal is the single highest-value data unlock for this dashboard

Some 'outstanding' orders in the Kobas report carry Order Placed dates back to 2024 and still show status=pending - almost certainly abandoned/never closed out in the source system rather than a live backlog; the aging table includes them as-is

Ingredient price changes carry no supplier or site field in the source report, so price rises cannot be joined to a specific supplier or location - shown as a standalone watchlist, not cross-referenced to suppliers.issues

Cross-reference site-alias map does not cover every site: 'Fountain Good Food Ltd', 'M1TOO Ltd', 'Maki Meadowhall' and 'Maki Property Ltd' appear in GetCompliant with no confirmed Kobas venue match, and 'Maki 1/2 (Nicolson St)', 'Maki Fountainbridge', 'Maki Leith', 'Maki Manchester NQ', 'Maki West End' and 'Maki Yorkshire' appear in Kobas with no GetCompliant broth-check match - these sites are excluded from cross-referencing until the alias map is extended, never guessed at

This snapshot's quality/supply/cross_ref blocks are HAND-BAKED (14/08/2026) from live browser-driven Neon queries, not a scheduled Pipe 9 run - broth cells cover 05-13 Aug only, fulfilment covers the top 20 of 32 suppliers by value, and price_watch covers the top 15 of 223 ingredients by % change. Merging PR #1 and adding WAREHOUSE_DSN to makiramen/ops Actions secrets lets the scheduled run replace this with the full cut automatically.

broth.basis: one cell per site + check-type + day from GC Scheduled Task Answers, deduped by AnswerID across pulls; hand-baked for 05-13 Aug 2026 (this snapshot's available window) - the scheduled Pipe 9 run extends this day by day; 'checks_missed' ==checks means every reading that day was non-numeric (e.g. 'Not registered on time'); event-dated on AnsweredDateTime, never pull_date
broth.spec_basis: factory spec band, refractometer reading AFTER ice (Ross, 27 Aug 2026): tonkotsu 8.0-9.0, chicken 5.0-6.0. One band per broth across the whole estate because the broth is made to it at the factory; each cell carries 'spec' as low/in/high, or null where no numeric reading landed that day

supply.fulfilment_basis: one row per Order ID (deduped across weekly pulls, latest pull wins) from the Kobas Outstanding Stock Orders report; hand-baked to the top 20 of 32 suppliers by £ value - the scheduled Pipe 9 run carries all 32; value_gbp/overdue counts are a proxy for OTIF, not a measured fulfilment rate. 'Supplier/Sending Venue' includes internal sending venues (e.g. AA Factory1 Limited, an internal commissary) alongside external suppliers, not purely third-party

supply.price_watch_basis: latest pull of the Kobas Weekly Ingredient Price Changes report; pct_change=(new-old)/old*100; hand-baked to the top 15 by absolute % change out of 223 ingredients - the scheduled Pipe 9 run carries the full list. Some swings here (e.g. Tenderstem Broccoli GBP0.0107 -> GBP2.13) look like unit/data-entry errors rather than real price movements - shown as-is, not filtered, since correcting them would mean guessing the right unit

cross_ref.basis: coincidence, NOT causation: every broth deviation (GC Scheduled Task Answers, IsDeviation=true) paired with any supplier issue (GC Form Task Answers, delivery/supplier forms) at the SAME site within +/-3 days by event date; join key is site+date via the hand-built SITE_ALIASES map, since site names differ across systems (e.g. 'Maki SJQ Ltd' vs 'Maki SJQ'). This snapshot found none within 3 days of each other - not a bug, a genuinely small-n absence, worth re-checking once more history accumulates
